Pricing

Scales with your practice.
Not against it.

You pay for the clients you have. Not the seats you might fill. No feature gates. No multi-year lock-ins. One annual contract, billed monthly, priced by your active client roster.

Client-based pricing

One price per active client slot. Covers everything the platform does for that client across the entire year. A boutique firm with five clients pays for five. An enterprise practice with fifty pays for fifty.

Usage that moves with you

Compute scales with activity. Submission season is intense. The months between are quieter. Your costs reflect that rhythm naturally. You are not locked into a flat premium year-round.

No seat limits. Ever.

Your entire firm operates on one account. Associates, principals, partners. Everyone has access to every module. Capiro is the operating environment for your practice.
